title: Radix pass after copying sorted indices
statement: Let $A$ be radix-pass arguments, let $\mu$ be the initial memory, let $\pi$ be a list of natural-number indices, and let $kd$ assign a natural-number key to each index. Suppose the radix-pass precondition holds, and the associated counting-sort postcondition holds in memory $\mu_1$, with the item at position $j$ taken to be the $j$th entry of $\pi$ (or zero when $j$ is out of range) and its key taken to be the key of that item (using zero for an out-of-range entry). Suppose also that $\mu_2(A.perm+i)=\mu_1(A.perm+A.w+i)$ for every $i<A.w$, and that $\mu_1$ and $\mu_2$ agree outside the interval starting at $A.perm$ of length $A.w$. Then the radix-pass postcondition holds for $\mu_2$.
hypotheses_covered: The associated counting-sort postcondition holds in $\mu_1$ with the specified item and key functions
$\mu_1$ and $\mu_2$ agree outside the interval starting at $A.perm$ of length $A.w$
